new_series.title: Bill's Included
new_series.synopsis: When Bill’s wife walks out on him for the gardener, he’s left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students.

new_series.title: The Witch Farm
new_series.synopsis: In summer 1989, Bill and Liz move to a remote farmhouse in the Brecon Beacons. But when Liz hears footsteps one night, the family are forced to accept a terrifying new reality.

new_series.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
new_series.synopsis: Lucy has the keys to the Doge’s Palace in Venice, where she has a close shave in a torture chamber and discovers a 24-carat gold staircase, hidden doors and secret messages.

new_series.title: Intrigue
new_series.synopsis: A billion-pound scandal. A council in financial ruin. Investigative journalists Catrin Nye and Meirion Jones uncover how public money was lost - and who's got it.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: Mike Walker's adaptation of Victor Hugo's classic blockbuster about love and redemption culminating atop the barricades. An epic tale of love and hope winning over impossible odds.

new_series.title: I'm Sorry I Haven't A Clue
new_series.synopsis: Jack Dee visits Wimbledon with panellists Sandi Toksvig, Richard Coles, Lucy Porter and Tony Hawks.

new_series.title: World of Secrets
new_series.synopsis: Prisoners sold their skin for survival in mid-century America. But nobody knew how far the testing programme at Holmesburg Prison would go.
